title: Specification overlay for Spec-Driven Development (EARS-enforced)
description: Overlays the baseline `spec.schema.json` with EARS five-pattern enforcement on functional_requirements[].statement. Activated when frontmatter declares `methodology: sdd` (or through a project default_methodology / Skill default). Supports ubiquitous, event-driven, state-driven, unwanted-behavior and optional-feature patterns in English and Japanese.

statement.pattern: ^((The system shall |When .+, the system shall |While .+, the system shall |If .+, then the system shall |Where .+, the system shall )|(システムは|もし.+(なら|であれば|場合)、システムは|.+(とき|時|間|場合|後|ごとに|時に)、システムは)).+$
statement.description: EARS format. English patterns: 'The system shall ...' (ubiquitous), 'When <trigger>, the system shall ...' (event-driven), 'While <state>, the system shall ...' (state-driven), 'If <condition>, then the system shall ...' (unwanted), and 'Where <feature>, the system shall ...' (optional). Japanese EARS forms are also recognized by the validation pattern.
